question: What is the most important driving technique to avoid crashes when driving in icy or snowy conditions?
choices: Add extra weight to the vehicle to improve traction.
Get off the highways as quickly as possible.
Engage 4 wheel drive on the vehicle.
Reduce speed and increase following distance

question: A flashing red traffic signal at an intersection has the same requirements as which of the following?
choices: A slow sign
A yield sign
A stop sign
An intersection sign

Unless it is posted otherwise, the speed limit in a residential area is:
choices: 25 miles per hour
20 miles per hour
35 miles per hour
15 miles per hour

question: Child restraints are required for:
choices: Infants and children who are either or both under the age of 4 and weigh less than 40 pounds must be properly restrained in an approved child safety seat while being transported in a motor vehicle. Also, any child who is at least 4 years of age but less than 8 years of age must be properly restrained in a booster seat unless the child is 4’9” or taller.
All children for whom the driver of the car is the parent or guardian
All children who are seated in the front seat
All children who are under the age of 6 when air bags are not available

question: When traveling on a highway divided into four traffic lanes, which vehicles are required to stop for a school bus that has stopped to unload children?
choices: Only vehicles approaching the rear of the bus traveling in the same direction as the bus
All vehicles approaching the bus from either direction
No one is required to stop unless children are in view
All vehicles may pass the bus after providing an audible signal

question: When two vehicles arrive at an intersection at the same time, which one has the right-of-way when no signs or signals indicate rules?
choices: The car approaching from the right has the right of way.
The car approaching from the left has the right-of-way.
The car in which the driver sounds his horn first has the right of way.
The car that is traveling faster has the right-of-way.

question: If someone has consumed alcoholic drinks, what will help the person overcome the influence of those drinks?
choices: Tomato juice and lime
Hot coffee
Fresh air
Time

question: When is a driver permitted to turn right on a red traffic signal?
choices: When the driver has stopped and checked to see that the turn will not interfere with crossing traffic
When signs are clearly posted to allow a right turn on red
Only at the direction of a police officer
After first slowing and verifying the turn will interfere with other traffic and pedestrians

question: When a stop is required at an intersection and no markings appear to indicate a stop line or crosswalk, which of the following is the appropriate place to make the stop?
choices: The driver is not required to stop
The driver is required to slow down to make sure crossing traffic is clear
Only at a place where the driver can see at least 200 feet on either side without regard for the intersecting roadway
At the point nearest the intersecting roadway where the driver has a view of approaching traffic on the intersecting roadway before actually entering the roadway
